intro.headline: Three phases, one shared platform where it pays.
intro.lede: Three phases, one shared platform where it pays. Over-Ear ships first because TTM is shortest and ETL pre-approved PS paths exist. Core-like + Symphony share tooling and ship together. The Instrument lands as halo when the rest of the line is already in market and the Krell vacuum is still open.

points.title: Over-Ear ships first
points.body: Fastest TTM in the line, ETL pre-approved power supply paths. Establishes AGF in market, funds the rest of the line, validates the channel.

points.title: Core-like and Symphony together
points.body: Shared tooling, three SKUs, one investment. The Symphony goes to long-lead reviewers at $29,990 and to retail at $2,990.

points.title: The Instrument, then the return of Wasted Real-Estate
points.body: The halo lands while Krell rebuilds dealer trust. The suppressed Dolby concept returns, paired with five venue pilots, and the backstory carries the launch.

deep.headline: Launch Roadmap — sequencing the line.
deep.lede: Three phases, one shared platform where it pays. Over-Ear ships first because TTM is shortest and ETL pre-approved PS paths exist. Core-like + Symphony share tooling and ship together. The Instrument lands as halo when the rest of the line is already in market and the Krell vacuum is still open.
deep.note: The document drew this as a 24-month Gantt with milestone markers for PR stunts, venue pilots and volume targets. The Gantt is queued for the next pass; the timeline below carries the same months.

items.title: Phase 1 — Over-Ear Home Centric (fastest to market)
items.body:
**Fastest TTM in the line.** Hardware ~80% complete (refactor for aesthetic + control mods + 6-end-point charge QA). Software ~70% (l'Art algos + 6-end-point concurrent stream). Ships first to establish AGF in market, fund the rest of the line, and validate the channel.

• V1 SKU ships with RF-default dock + BT 5.3 (SBC/AAC/aptX/aptX HD/LDAC)
• ETL/FCC/CE certification (~$30K budget)
• Channel introductions to stranded Polk/Definitive/McIntosh independents
• V2 refactor scoped — execution in 8–12 months ($120K tooling)
• 1000 pcs/mo (month 5, target)

items.title: Phase 2 — Core-like Small (shared platform)
items.body:
**Shared tooling.** Core-like small shares electronics platform with the soundbar. Three SKUs, one tooling investment.

• Shared electronics platform freeze (l'Art module + power supply)
• Mechanical tooling complete (Core-like ID)
• ETL/FCC/CE certification (~$30K)

items.title: Phase 2 — Core-like Soundbar (shared platform)
items.body:
**Shared tooling, mid-sandwich pricing.** Core-like soundbar shares the small unit's electronics platform.

• Mechanical tooling complete (soundbar ID)
• ETL/FCC/CE certification (~$30K)

items.title: Phase 2 — Symphony Macro-System
items.body:
**Mid-sandwich pricing.** Symphony shares manufacturing partners and certification budget with Core-like. $2,990 retail with the $29,990 review-tier anchor.

• Symphony **PR stunt: submitted for review at $29,990, corrected post-submission to $2,990**
• Mechanical tooling complete (Symphony transmission-line cabinet)
• ETL/FCC/CE certification (~$30K)
• $29,990 PR Stunt (month 10, pr)

items.title: Phase 3 — The Instrument (flagship halo)
items.body:
**Halo product, halo timing.** Lands just above Focal's consumer flagship (~$5K) while Krell is still rebuilding dealer trust. Pro-tier UI empowers live-mixing techs to submit innovations (royalty-paid) — feeds Balcony installations at flagship venues.

• Companion GaN mono-block + Gowin FPGA processor + transmission-line sub validated
• Three-mode platform shipped (audiophile / pro / measurement)
• Royalty-paid third-party innovation pipeline open through Balcony
• ETL/FCC/CE certification (~$30K)

items.title: Phase 3 — Wasted Real-Estate (suppressed product return)
items.body:
**Suppressed Dolby concept returns.** Originally killed by Apple licensing threat — the backstory itself carries the launch. Paired with venue pilots to land 1,000 pcs/mo Year-1 globally across 100+ retail partners.

• 5-market venue pilots active
• Channel: 100+ retail partners onboarded
• 1,000 pcs/mo run-rate validated
• Venue Pilot (month 14, venue)

sections.title: Two stunts, timed to the sequence

items.eyebrow: Phase 2 — submitted to long-lead reviewers ahead of retail availability
items.title: Symphony Review-Tier Anchor
items.body: **Symphony Macro-System submitted for review at $29,990**, then corrected post-submission to **$2,990 retail**. The press receives the unit at the prestige-audio price; the customer buys it at the mass-premium price. Anchors the perceived ceiling, then drops the ladder.

items.eyebrow: Phase 2–3 — paired with the Instrument launch for narrative density
items.title: Wasted Real-Estate Suppression Story
items.body: Originally concepted at Dolby; Apple shut it down via licensing threat. The story itself is the launch — channel-probe-positive, vetted, the suppressed product returns. PR earns its keep with the backstory, not the spec sheet.

sections.title: First five markets
sections.body:
**First 5 financially qualifying markets.** Selection by (a) density of arts-aware sophisticated audio buyers, (b) local performing-arts ecosystem strength, (c) availability of an owner-operator partner willing to host the FoH/Balcony/Green Room blueprint. **One venue per market — never two.**

Pilots double as Phase 2/3 launch surfaces — l'Art Production line in the Balcony, full consumer line in the Green Room, virtual all-access pass bundled with hardware ownership.

sections.title: 1,000 pieces a month, globally
sections.body:
**Wasted Real-Estate Y1 target: 1,000 pcs/month globally** with 100+ retail partners (100 pcs/mo across 2 PoC venues). Comparable: **Focal's flagship reference moves ~1,000 pcs/month** with a focused rep firm — the volume is real and reachable in Y1.

Y1 unit volume compounds across the line: Over-Ear (Phase 1) carries the run-rate, Core-like + Symphony (Phase 2) build margin, the Instrument (Phase 3) opens the halo — and Wasted Real-Estate validates the case-as-product thesis at 1,000 pcs/mo.

sections.title: Phased rollout to year five
sections.body:
**Phase 1 (Year 1):** Inaugural product line ships from existing IP base. Single flagship venue (PoC). Channel introductions to stranded independents.

**Phase 2 (Years 2–3):** Second-wave AGF community franchises — venues replicating the FoH/Balcony/Green Room blueprint globally. l'Art codec adoption seeded through Balcony installations.

**Phase 3 (Years 3–5):** stereOS third-party adoption. Acquisition / hostile-service / integration decision for ten-ton gorillas. AGF as future bank-roller for stranded distribution channels.
